business_problem: Project Ruby brings all of this data together onto Google Cloud, taking advantage of its cohesive AI ecosystem to deliver insights into everything happening across Virgin Voyages. BigQuery unifies all data streams into one location, ingesting data from Salesforce, Seaware reservation systems, websites, onboard sales terminals, and crew tablets.
solution_summary: Ships run local Ruby agents on Google Distributed Cloud at the edge to ensure resilience for ship-level systems during offline operations while ships are at sea. While Virgin Voyages uses BigQuery to store data for analytics and model training, it uses Firestore for operational profiles and edge sync, plus Cloud Storage for assets. Meanwhile, Pub/Sub and Dataflow pipelines handle data enrichment and data loss prevention (DLP) checks. "Most organizations are drowning in data they can't act on. BigQuery, Gemini platform, and Gemini solve the translation problem—from raw signal to readily accessible, decision-ready intelligence," says Saverimuttu. Virgin Voyages uses not only Gemini models' sophisticated reasoning, but also the text-to-video capabilities in Veo and a text-to-image workflow with Imagen to create a test for its "Postcards From Your Future Self" campaign, due to roll out this year.
